name: Monkio
summary:
Monkio is a high-energy VR movement game inspired by Gorilla Tag, focused on skill-based locomotion and fast-paced multiplayer gameplay. Using only your hands, you climb, push, swing, and launch yourself across carefully designed maps that reward momentum, timing, and creativity. There are no traditional movement controls-every action depends on your physical motion, making movement feel natural, competitive, and deeply rewarding to master.
